entry.title: India Less Exposed to AI Job Risks Than Others, Goldman Says
entry.summary: India’s labor force is unlikely to face widespread job losses from artificial intelligence, though some positions in the services sector could be affected, Goldman Sachs Group’s Chief India economist Santanu Sengupta said Friday.
